mode_rule: mode0 uses count of nonzero flags of current schedule; any nonzero mode uses24 hours.
schedule6: Temporary closure is a real seventh data row with zero hourly flags; normal operation-menu code can assign index6.
equipment: Sum rate*hours for each grid anchor(bit31 set) whose fixture id=(word>>12)&1023 is<53. Count once per anchor; do not multiply by footprint or remaining stock.
staff: For each assigned ref!=-1: read signed i32 wage base at staff+12. Slot0 applies trunc_toward_zero(wage*130/100) before multiplying by hours; slots1/2 use wage as-is.
staff_scope: No actual-worktime, task, rest or energy filter in these cost helpers.
daily_debit: At native296F0..297A4 write equipment cost to store+D88 and staff cost to+D8C, then debit these plus existing+D90 from owning side cash. This report does not assign a new label or recalculation formula to+D90.
arithmetic: Source uses signed32 operations and truncation toward zero; examples here use normal nonnegative amounts.
currency: Preserve source amounts; purchase display units and other monetary conversions are outside this report.
